calculate_rmsd_between_structures: calculate the RMSD between two molecular structures by aligning atoms from ORCA and MLIP results
compute_interaction_energy_and_forces: compute the interaction energy and forces for a supersystem like a ligand-pocket complex from component results
evaluate_ligand_pocket_metrics: evaluate MAE metrics for energy, forces, interaction energy, and interaction forces in ligand pocket tasks
